incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: Puxin AI opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart Puxin AI.

incompleteInstallation.title: Puxin AI installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Contact your administrator.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Contact your administrator.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: Puxin AI package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This Puxin AI package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: Puxin AI opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling Puxin AI may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: Puxin AI opened, but AionCore stopped while repairing local agent cache data. Reinstalling Puxin AI may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: Puxin AI detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, Puxin AI will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB
